title: Passing Knowledge Across Generations
goal: I can contrast instantaneous/semelfactive verb stems (-int/-ant, -an/-en) with their iterative counterparts (-gat/-get, -og/-eg/-ög)
I can choose the exact verbal aspect for a single flash, knock, or glance versus sustained rhythm
I can describe traditional crafts, acoustic textures, and natural phenomena
